verdicts.reason: Both are tiny shrunken copies of the square layout centred in a wide banner. Large empty white bands sit on either side, and the headline and body copy are illegible at this size, so neither is rearranged for the banner format. B is a little worse because a stray dark striped block (probably the brush stroke that was meant to sit under the headline) is floating loose between the text and the crane photo, which adds a visible collision and grouping error.
